description: Turns the knobs, faders, wheel and bend of an Arturia MiniLab 3 into control voltages, and hands the same surfaces over to a chain of MiniPad expanders whenever one of the controller's pads is held

outputs.text: Carries 5V while a MIDI device is chosen and no pad on the controller is being held, and 0V while a pad is held or no device is chosen, so it says which module in the chain the knobs are reaching
Follows the controller's pitch bend wheel, -5V fully down, 0V at rest and 5V fully up
Follows the controller's modulation wheel, 0V to 10V
The value piled up by turning that numbered knob on the controller: each click of the encoder moves it by the turn speed set on this jack's own right-click menu, and the total is scaled to 0V to 10V
Follows that numbered fader on the controller, 0V to 10V, and the faders are read whether or not a pad is being held

notes: nothing comes out until a MIDI driver, device and channel are chosen in the display at the top of the panel; with none chosen the status light is dim and every jack stays where it was
channel 16 is reserved: the module uses it to talk to the MiniPad expanders, so choosing it here puts the channel back to all channels
MiniPad expanders go immediately to the right, chained one after another, and each takes the driver, device and channel from here; a MiniLog goes immediately to the left
while any pad on the controller is held, this module stops following the knobs, wheel, bend and aftertouch and that pad's expander follows them instead; the faders always come out here
the velocity and aftertouch outputs exist in the module but have no jack on this panel; they are on the MiniPad expanders instead
menu: Slew limit — a slider on each output jack's own right-click menu, setting how long that jack takes to reach a new value, from none up to 2 seconds
Mode: 0V:1V, 0V:5V, 0V:10V, -1V:1V, -5V:5V, -10V:10V — on each output jack's own right-click menu, setting the voltage range that jack's value is scaled into
Resolution: Two, Three, Four, Five, Eight, Twelve, Low, Medium, High — on a knob jack's own right-click menu, setting how many steps the knob's travel is divided into, two up to 8192
Turn Speed: 1, 2, 10, 1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, Toggle — on a knob jack's own right-click menu, setting how far one click of the encoder moves the value
